4.shows: the real Roman Space Telescope hardware being assembled in a clean room before launch
4.line: Roman's main mirror is the same width as Hubble's, yet each image covers at least one hundred times more sky.

6.shows: the real Roman Coronagraph Instrument in a JPL clean room and the instruments being integrated into the Roman observatory
6.line: Why so steady? Its coronagraph is designed to block a star's glare and reveal planets one hundred million times fainter.
